short_description: Vice Replay Rankings: the top 3 rides seen in Rockstar's own GTA 6 gameplay ("GTA VI: An Extended Look"), ranked by us. The ranking is our opinion; what each clip shows is described as it appears on screen (the dirt-bike race shows 12 riders, the street race HUD shows 6 racers). No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar gameplay, original audio removed.
